hook.en: An analog meter makes you judge where a needle points. A digital multimeter simply shows the number, and loads the circuit far less while doing it.
hook.kn: ಅನಲಾಗ್ ಮೀಟರ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಸೂಚಿ ಎಲ್ಲಿದೆ ಎಂದು ನಾವು ಅಂದಾಜು ಮಾಡಬೇಕು. ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ಮಲ್ಟಿಮೀಟರ್ ನೇರವಾಗಿ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯನ್ನು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಮಂಡಲದ ಮೇಲೆ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಭಾರ ಹಾಕುತ್ತದೆ.

objectives.en: Draw the block diagram of a DMM
Explain the meaning of 3½ digits, resolution and accuracy

narration.en: An analog meter makes you judge where a needle points. A digital multimeter simply shows the number, and loads the circuit far less while doing it.
narration.kn: ಅನಲಾಗ್ ಮೀಟರ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಸೂಚಿ ಎಲ್ಲಿದೆ ಎಂದು ನಾವು ಅಂದಾಜು ಮಾಡಬೇಕು. ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ಮಲ್ಟಿಮೀಟರ್ ನೇರವಾಗಿ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯನ್ನು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಮಂಡಲದ ಮೇಲೆ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಭಾರ ಹಾಕುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: In a digital multimeter, the input stage (attenuator for voltage, shunts for current, a constant-current source for resistance, a precision rectifier for a.c.) turns the quantity into a d.c. voltage in a fixed range. An analog-to-digital converter (ADC), usually a dual-slope type, converts this voltage into a count. A counter and decoder drive a seven-segment LCD or LED display that shows the value with its decimal point, unit and sign.

points.en: Everything is converted to a d.c. voltage first

narration.en: A digital multimeter first turns the quantity into a d.c. voltage, the ADC converts that into a count, and the decoder shows it on the display.
narration.kn: ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ಮಲ್ಟಿಮೀಟರ್ ಮೊದಲು ಪರಿಮಾಣವನ್ನು ನೇರ ವೋಲ್ಟೇಜ್ ಆಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; ADC ಅದನ್ನು ಎಣಿಕೆಯಾಗಿ ಬದಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; ಡಿಕೋಡರ್ ಅದನ್ನು ಪ್ರದರ್ಶಕದಲ್ಲಿ ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: Whatever you measure, voltage, current or resistance, the input stage first turns it into a d.c. voltage in a suitable range.
The analog-to-digital converter turns that voltage into a number of counts.
A counter and decoder drive the seven-segment display, which shows the reading with its decimal point and sign.
A three-and-a-half digit display reads up to 1999: three full digits and a leading half digit that is only 0 or 1.
Resolution is one count. On the 2 volt range that is one millivolt. Accuracy is quoted as a percentage of the reading plus a few counts.

narration.en: On the board: Inside a digital multimeter.

body.en: A 3½-digit display has three full digits and a leading half digit (0 or 1), so it shows up to 1999 counts. The resolution is one count: on the 2 V range it is 1 mV. Accuracy is quoted as ±(a % of reading + n counts). Compared with an analog meter, a DMM has a high input impedance (about 10 MΩ), no parallax or reading error, automatic polarity and often auto-ranging; but it needs a battery and is less convenient for watching a quantity that keeps changing.

narration.en: A three-and-a-half digit meter reads up to 1999. Its resolution is one count, and its high input impedance means it hardly loads the circuit.
narration.kn: ಮೂರೂವರೆ ಅಂಕಿಯ ಮೀಟರ್ 1999 ರವರೆಗೆ ಓದುತ್ತದೆ. ಅದರ ವಿಭೇದನ ಒಂದು ಎಣಿಕೆ; ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಇನ್‌ಪುಟ್ ಪ್ರತಿರೋಧದಿಂದ ಮಂಡಲದ ಮೇಲೆ ಭಾರ ಬಹಳ ಕಡಿಮೆ.

caption.en: Explore a DMM display. Choose the number of full digits (3 means a 3½-digit meter), the range and the reading, and see the resolution and the possible error.

tryThis.en: 3½ digits, 2 V range, 1.5 V reading at 0.5 %: check the error against the board example (±9.5 mV).
Go to a 4½-digit meter (N = 4). How does the resolution change?
Measure 0.15 V on the 20 V range and then on the 2 V range. Which gives the smaller error? Why?

narration.en: Explore a DMM display. Choose the number of full digits (3 means a 3½-digit meter), the range and the reading, and see the resolution and the possible error.

problem.en: A 3½-digit DMM on its 2 V range shows 1.500 V. Its accuracy is ±(0.5 % of reading + 2 counts). Find the resolution and the range within which the true value lies.

steps.en: Maximum reading 1.999 V, so one count = 0.001 V = 1 mV (resolution).
Total error = ±9.5 mV, so the true value lies between 1.4905 V and 1.5095 V.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A 3½-digit DMM on its 2 V range shows 1.500 V. Its accuracy is ±(0.5 % of reading + 2 counts). Find the resolution and the range within which the true value lies.

body.en: The half digit is the leading digit that can only be 0 or 1. So 3½ digits = 1999, 4½ digits = 19999. Count the 9s for the full digits.

narration.en: What is the "half" digit?. The half digit is the leading digit that can only be 0 or 1. So 3½ digits = 1999, 4½ digits = 19999. Count the 9s for the full digits.

narration.kn: ರೋಲ್ ಕಾಲ್ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಕರೆದ ಕ್ರಮಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿ ಉತ್ತರಿಸಲಿ.

points.en: DMM: input stage → ADC → decoder → display.
points.kn: DMM: ಇನ್‌ಪುಟ್ ಹಂತ → ADC → ಡಿಕೋಡರ್ → ಪ್ರದರ್ಶಕ.

points.en: Resolution = one count; accuracy = ±(% of reading + counts).
High input impedance (about 10 MΩ) means little loading.
points.kn: ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಇನ್‌ಪುಟ್ ಪ್ರತಿರೋಧ (ಸುಮಾರು 10 MΩ) ಎಂದರೆ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಭಾರ.

homework.en: Draw the block diagram of a digital multimeter and explain each block.
Give four differences between analog and digital multimeters.

narration.en: Recap. DMM: input stage → ADC → decoder → display. 3½ digits: maximum reading 1999. Resolution = one count; accuracy = ±(% of reading + counts). High input impedance (about 10 MΩ) means little loading.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. DMM: ಇನ್‌ಪುಟ್ ಹಂತ → ADC → ಡಿಕೋಡರ್ → ಪ್ರದರ್ಶಕ. 3½ ಅಂಕಿಗಳು: ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ಓದು 1999. ವಿಭೇದನ = ಒಂದು ಎಣಿಕೆ; ನಿಖರತೆ = ±(ಓದಿನ % + ಎಣಿಕೆಗಳು). ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಇನ್‌ಪುಟ್ ಪ್ರತಿರೋಧ (ಸುಮಾರು 10 MΩ) ಎಂದರೆ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಭಾರ.
